column5: The clown was dejected, their performance had only brought upon disappointment.
At the time, the performance fascinated me. Such depth of despair felt by the clown, brought on by the audience.
It was an interesting little trick of the audience, to reverse the impact of the performance, and to leave everyone feeling disappointed.
But, a trick that needs so many people, must be a bit unimpressive, no?
But, I now have my own little trick too.
